title: Chronic kidney disease: stage, hypertension and dialysis status
question: Assign the ICD-10-CM codes for the patient's kidney disease and any related hypertension and dialysis status.
note:
Chief Complaint
Follow-up for chronic kidney disease.

HPI
The patient is a 58-year-old male presenting for a routine follow-up of chronic kidney disease. He reports feeling well overall and denies any new symptoms of fatigue, edema, or changes in urinary output. He reports compliance with his current medications and has been monitoring his blood pressure at home. He reports no recent changes in diet or activity level.

Medication List
Lisinopril 20mg daily
Hydrochlorothiazide 12.5mg daily

Exam
The patient is alert and oriented x3. Vital signs are stable. Blood pressure is 138/84 mmHg. Heart rate is 72 bpm. Lungs are clear to auscultation. No pedal edema noted. Skin is warm and dry.

Assessment
1. Chronic kidney disease, stage 3a
2. Hypertension

Plan
1. Continue current medications for management of hypertension and chronic kidney disease.
2. Patient instructed to maintain a low-sodium diet.
3. Follow up in three months for lab work including serum creatinine and electrolytes.
explanations: Hypertension with CKD is presumed linked: I12.9 for CKD stage 1-4 (sequenced first), plus the N18 stage code.

distractors.why: The classification presumes a link between hypertension and CKD.
I12.0 is for stage 5 or ESRD only.
Stage 3a is documented; do not use unspecified stage 3.
